_comment: Accepted out-of-range override edges for scripts/check-override-ranges.mjs (#3167).
Each entry says: this parent is knowingly given a version outside the range it
declared, because an override in package.json forces it. Match key is
"<parent> -> <name>" (version-independent, so bumping the override target does
not silently change what was approved — re-read the reason when the version moves).
Add an entry only with a reason. Prefer a version-scoped override over a new entry:

_schema.parent: lock key with the node_modules/ prefix stripped
_schema.name: overridden package
_schema.forced_by: the override entry in package.json that wins

entries.name: esbuild
entries.reason: Deliberate nested override: the 0.18 line is what the advisory-free build needs. Scope is already limited to this parent, so no other esbuild consumer is touched.

entries.name: uuid
entries.reason: Deliberate nested override off the deprecated uuid 8.x line. exceljs only uses v4 generation, whose call shape is unchanged in 11.x.

entries.name: ws
entries.reason: Blanket ws floor set to clear the ws advisory. The only consumer it now forces: dev-time ANALYZE build path, default connect/send surface only. (lighthouse declared ws ^7.0.0 until 13.6.0 dropped the dependency, and the guard proved the approval stale.)
